rationale: EP-B70E718D F4 (BI-C5CD9EAE) and F5 (BI-0FB4A049). The area Work view opens with five fixed flow measures: in flow now, flow time median with trend, flow efficiency, finished per week, and cost. Below them is the mix of work types and a short table of the area's work shapes, each naming where its rooms wait. Choosing a shape opens a drill-in on the same route (?shape=) using the same flow-map component as the room page, with a version picker for before and after. Choosing a step lists its rooms. /portfolio gets one comparison table: the four portfolios plus Unplaced on the same measures. No new route or input. Rejected: a new /flow dashboard route (another home, everything at once) and charts only on /performance (no drill-in to the step or the rooms).
verification: AreaFlowPanel.test.tsx (jsdom) covers the five measures with prior-window change, shape links and bottleneck wording, empty and no-history states with dashes instead of invented numbers, the drill-in's queue counts, version picker and rooms at a step, and the four-plus-Unplaced comparison. portfolio-flow.test.ts covers flow time, efficiency (a step that was only waited on counts as zero touch), throughput, prior window, live load, mix, bottleneck and the unplaced bucket.
